context: Evaluates whether the model uses EventsOnce (or EventsOnMultiple with maxCallbacks=1) to register a listener that fires exactly once and is then automatically removed. The key challenge is knowing that EventsOnce exists and that it returns a cancel function for early removal.

checklist.name: EventsOnce or EventsOnMultiple(1)
checklist.description: EventsOnce from @wailsapp/runtime is called (or EventsOnMultiple with maxCallbacks set to 1) to register the one-time listener

checklist.name: Cancel function returned
checklist.description: once returns the cancel function provided by EventsOnce (or EventsOnMultiple), enabling the caller to remove the listener before it fires

checklist.name: Correct arguments
checklist.description: eventName and handler are passed in the correct order to EventsOnce (or EventsOnMultiple)

checklist.name: Single invocation guaranteed
checklist.description: The implementation ensures the handler fires at most once without requiring manual cleanup by the caller
